identity.name: Sodium adipate
identity.chemical_class: Sodium salt(s) of adipic acid (dicarboxylate acidulant/buffer salts)

function.mechanism: Provides adipate-based acid-base buffering and pH adjustment in formulated foods.

adi.basis: EFSA search and OpenFoodTox row-level retrieval were blocked in this environment; no EFSA ADI value could be extracted for E356 in this run.

efsa.key_finding: Direct EFSA extraction was blocked (search/robots and dashboard data authorization), so latest EFSA opinion details for E356 could not be retrieved in this run.

adi.basis: Group ADI 0-5 mg/kg bw for adipic acid and its potassium, sodium and ammonium salts (free-acid basis).

concerns.summary: Older high-dose animal studies summarized by JECFA reported effects such as diarrhea and reduced growth at higher dietary doses.
Direct modern human safety and intake datasets specific to E356 were limited in retrieved sources, adding uncertainty to current exposure characterization.

no_concern_confirmed: JECFA established a group ADI of 0-5 mg/kg bw for adipic acid and potassium/sodium/ammonium salts.
JECFA monograph summaries reported no compound-related embryotoxic or teratogenic effects in tested species/dose ranges.
No IARC listing for sodium adipate or adipic acid was found in the current IARC classification dataset reviewed.

adi_exceedance.notes: Current E356-specific intake distributions were not retrieved in this run, so population ADI exceedance prevalence could not be quantified.

risk_assessment.rationale: JECFA provides a bounded historical group ADI with no strong carcinogenicity classification signal from IARC, and CFR has adipic-acid GRAS anchors, while major uncertainty remains due limited modern E356-specific exposure data and inability to extract EFSA details in this environment.
key_factors: JECFA sodium adipate page reports group ADI context and 2015 note that provisions were withdrawn at CCFA47
eCFR exact search did not find standalone 'sodium adipate' section text in Title 21
Closest U.S. regulatory anchors are adipic acid sections 21 CFR 184.1009 and 582.1009
No IARC entry found for sodium adipate/adipic acid in current list dataset
Recent PubMed direct sodium adipate hits were sparse and not core dietary safety outcome studies
